intro.zh: 设计师、博士研究生，探索时装与纺织品的更多可能。
intro.en: Designer and PhD student exploring new possibilities in fashion and textiles.

intro.zh: 这里记录我在博士研究中收集的材料。每种材料都有一份“材料档案”，参考欧盟数字产品护照的框架，记录它的来源、成分、特性与循环信息。
intro.en: A record of the materials collected during my PhD research. Each material has its own record, informed by the EU Digital Product Passport framework, documenting its origin, composition, properties and circularity.
